title: Azure Monitor: metrics, diagnostic settings and data collection rules

videos.script: Every Azure resource produces numbers from the moment it exists. {{metrics}} CPU, requests, latency. They are kept for you, for three months, with nothing to configure. The logs are different. A resource writes them, and Azure throws them away, unless you say where they go. {{logs}} That instruction is a diagnostic setting. For a virtual machine, it is a data collection rule. {{rules}} This lesson writes both in Bicep, and shows the one place a rule can filter before you pay for what it keeps. {{end}}
